name: What is the typical timeline for plumbing work in a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for plumbing work in a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for plumbing work in a bathroom remodel depends on the scope of the project, ranging from a few days for minor fixture replacements to two weeks or more for extensive relocations or additions. This timeframe includes rough-in, pressure testing, and final fixture installation. Our project management in the East Bay area prioritizes efficient scheduling and coordination with other trades to minimize disruption and keep your remodel on track. Unexpected issues, like discovering lead pipes in an older Berkeley home, can extend this timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbing work for a bathroom remodel typically takes a few days to over two weeks, depending on the project's scope. Efficient scheduling is key.
